entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0080 does not recognize redundant null-forgiving operator inferred by MemberNotNullWhen #84214
  • Warn when using `returns` XML doc comment for void methods #84208

Closed

  • Nullable annotations are not displayed correctly in the tooltip/quick info #84010
  • Compiler crashes with NullReferenceException while compiling an assignment to an "event Action" #84014
    18.9

PullRequests

Created

  • Fba test multi sdk #84219
  • Use real MethodImplAttributes/Options when available #84218
  • Report analyzer and source generator timing by default #84217
  • Remove obsolete CS1998 suppressions #84216
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Fix GetOperation returning null for user-defined conversions to nullable types #84215
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3004071 #84213
  • Investigation: Nullable analysis doesn't track property state across decision dags #84212
  • Extension indexers: record feature as merged #84211
    Documentation, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Extension indexers: Add test suggestions from test plan review #84210
    Area-Compilers, Test, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Adjust decision Dag reachability based on nullable analysis when reporting unhandled `null` values in a switch expression #84207
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Reduce lsp server allocations by ~70% during load of already restored projects #84205
    VSCode
  • Optimize todo-check.ps1 and have it check for merge markers #84204
  • [Sonic] Support multiple C# documents in code actions #84203
    Area-Razor
  • Restore solution as a whole on auto-load instead of per-project #84202
    VSCode

Merged

  • Fixes Hot reload logging in DevKit #84179
    VSCode
  • Cap Razor completion lists at 1000 items to avoid pooling issues with large JsonDocument byte[] #84194
    Area-Razor
  • [Sonic] Minor cleanup #84181
    Area-Razor
  • EnC session tracker cleanup #84201
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Include nullable annotations in quick-info tooltip for delegates #84195
    VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3003990 #84209
  • [release/insiders] Hot Reload: Temporarily disable project-level analysis #84161
  • Merge "extension indexers" into main branch #84200
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Merge "extension indexers" into `main` branch #84197
    Feature - Extension Indexers
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84206
  • Use dedicated BindValueKind for left hand side of null coalescing assignment operator #84172
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Null Conditional Assignment
  • File-based apps: force using a single msbuild node for design-time builds #84183
    VSCode, Feature - Run File

Updated

  • [Sonic] Debugging and breakpoint bits #84166
    Area-Razor
  • Implement LSP daemon mode #84199
    VSCode
  • Add imports for child namespace references when moving types #84132
